pretreatments.description: Ultrasonic pretreatment was applied to excess sludge using an ultrasonicator with a frequency of 20 kHz, 750 W power, and 40% amplitude. Treatment times varied from 5 to 60 minutes. The sludge was centrifuged at 10,000 rpm for 20 minutes and filtered through a 0.45 μm pore size membrane to obtain the soluble fraction for subsequent analysis.

Alkaline pretreatment involved the addition of a 6 mol/L KOH solution to excess sludge to reach specific pH levels of 9, 10, 11, 12, and 13. The samples were mixed for 1 hour using a magnetic stirrer at 200 rpm. The injection of alkaline solution was continued throughout the hour to achieve and maintain the expected pH levels.

Combined pretreatment involved alkali-pretreated sludge at pH 9, 11, and 13 for 1 hour, followed by ultrasonication for 5, 20, and 60 minutes respectively, totaling nine combinations. After pretreatment, the sludge was centrifuged and filtered to obtain the soluble fraction.
